title: RingOfStrange
description: This is a mod for a ring belonging to the Doctor Strange from Marvel. By right-clicking while holding the ring, a menu opens where you can enter coordinates, and you will be teleported to the specified location.
body:
This is a mod for a ring belonging to the Doctor Strange from Marvel. By right-clicking while holding the ring, a menu opens where you can enter coordinates, and you will be teleported to the specified location.

There is currently no way to obtain the ring in survival mode to avoid imbalance if the mod is added to a server. However, if there are requests to add such a feature, I will definitely implement it.
